name: Sera Akito
source:
Kazuki Hoshino's best friend and high school classmate. He's calm and kind, and often stays over at Ichika's house. Akito loves music and often composes new songs that he demos for Kazuki.

[From the [url=http://www.aksysgames.com/malice/characters/]official English website[/url]]
